data.title: 椎名真昼 · 阳台晚风与发绳整理
data.description: 两户阳台只隔着短短的一道隔板。真昼手扶着栏杆，晚风将她耀眼的金发吹得微微凌乱。她抬起双手重新系紧发绳，侧头看向隔壁阳台端着热咖啡的周，唇角弯起罕见的、毫无伪装的天真笑容。
data.location: 高层公寓相通阳台栏杆旁
data.action: 双手抬起挽发整理发绳，微风拂动金发，侧颜回眸浅笑
data.lighting: 城市天际线暮色紫霞与阳台门廊暖光
data.camera: medium landscape two-shot from outside, adjacent balcony railings and divider
data.promptProse: Two neighboring apartments have separate balconies at dusk. A short divider and two separate railings span the foreground. On the left balcony, Mahiru raises both hands to retie her long blond hair over a cream sweater. On the right balcony, Amane has short black hair and wears a slate-blue shirt. He holds a mug of hot coffee and smiles across the divider. Warm light spills out of two different doorways.
